title: A Canary in the AI Coal Mine: American Jews May Be Disproportionately Harmed by Intellectual Property Dispossession in Large Language Model Training

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying Distinctive Jewish Names (DJNs) in author metadata across multiple LLM training datasets (e.g., PubMed Central, Books3, ArXiv, GitHub, FreeLaw), applying probabilistic demographic adjustments for coverage and precision, and calculating the relative magnitude of intellectual property dispossession for Jewish Americans compared to general baseline population demographics.

Analyzing the representation of specific IP-heavy professions (e.g., law, STEM, journalism) in LLM training datasets by mapping domain sources to job categories and cross-referencing this data with demographic employment statistics from the Bureau of Labor Statistics to estimate disproportionate labor substitution harms.
